title: 1:1 prep - Sophia Martin
body:
Purpose: quick sync / unblock / career check. ~30m.

Context: Sophia leads model caching and quantization infra work. Recent focus on the memory-leak investigation on the multi-tenant cache (JIRA-4812) and the caching PR (serving-runtime PR#879). She shipped the internal perf eval last week (good numbers) but hit flakiness on long sequences.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m quick personal catch-up (how week is going, morale)
- 10m project status: memory leak, flaky test, rollout plan for caching
- 5m blockers/needs from me (staffing, priority, infra reqs)
- 5m career: IC4 rubric, goals for next 6 months, mentorship
- 5m action review + next steps

Wins to call out:
- Shipping internal perf eval (latency down 18% on typical workload) — call this out to the team.
- Took ownership of PR triage while Alex was OOO.

Open/Risks:
- JIRA-4812: memory leak reproduces on long sequence runs in staging; root cause not yet found. Repro steps in ticket.
- Flaky integration test on long batches -> blocking canary rollout.
- Headcount: need another infra SWE or longer-term, a contractor to help with test infra; current bandwith limited.

Questions to ask Sophia:
- Does the leak reproduce locally if you run the exact staging config? If not, what differs?
- What mitigations can we do for the canary rollout to avoid customer impact? (e.g., traffic cap, shorter sequence cap, sampling)
- Do you want me to escalate for priority infra hours from platform-engineering?
- How do you feel about the IC4 rubric items we discussed last month — which ones feel still far vs near?

Notes / facts to bring up:
- PR#879 is ready for final review but I saw failing integration on the long seq job (link above). Recommend we land smaller parts (config toggles) first to reduce risk.
- Consider enabling the new cache in Dedicated only for initial rollout.

Career/Cadence discussion prompts:
- Specific examples to collect for IC4 rubric: leading cross-team design, shipping high-impact feature end-to-end, mentoring others, owning rollback/runbook.
- Ask whether she wants a formal skip-level 1:1 with VP to showcase work in next 8 weeks.

Immediate asks for me (manager):
- Remove A/B experiment pressure for 2 weeks so she can debug reliably.
- Fast-track one extra 20% infra allocation for test cluster if I can get approval.

Proposed action items (track in this doc):
- Sophia: add definitive repro script to JIRA-4812 + env config by 2025-02-20.
- Liam: ping platform-eng for a 20% test cluster allocation and update by 2025-02-19.
- Sophia: split PR#879 into (a) config flag + tests (b) perf changes; aim to land (a) by 2025-02-25.
- Liam & Sophia: schedule 30m triage with infra (platform-eng) this week — target 2025-02-19.
- Sophia: prepare 1-2 slides for skip-level (if wants) by 2025-03-01.

Follow-up plan:
- I will block 30m on Thu for the triage meeting and invite platform-eng and Alex.
- Quick async check-in mid-week; Sophia to drop short status in Slack channel (#eng-serving-runtime).

Notes to self (manager coaching points):
- Ask open questions; avoid jumping to root cause assumptions. Let her walk me through the repro.
- Encourage documenting small wins publicly (announce perf eval in eng-all).
- Remind to offer to escalate resource needs early.

Unresolved:
- Who will own postmortem if leak confirmed in prod path? (Need to decide during triage)

Slack/links to drop in 1:1: JIRA-4812, PR#879, perf eval doc (confluence link), test infra request form.

Quick bullets to send as pre-read to Sophia before the 1:1: "Have repro script or steps attached to JIRA-4812, bring your notes on where the leak may be, and any test permutations you've tried. I'll try to get platform-eng to join triage Thu."

Tone: supportive, pragmatic, unblocker. Keep the meeting focused on diagnosis and short-term mitigations + career check.

End of notes.
